title: A Unified Geometric Perspective on Zygmund's Maximal Function Conjecture and Related Questions for the Stein Hilbert Transform
summary: The Zygmund vector-field maximal function conjecture is a long-standing open problem in harmonic analysis. It is notoriously difficult in part because the vector-field maximal function is non-translation-invariant and lies beyond the scope of finite-type theory. Its resolution would yield a Lebesgue differentiation theorem along vector fields, i.e., pointwise recovery of functions from averages along vector fields.
